templates.title: Halter Familiarity
templates.goal: Develop a calm, voluntary halter familiarity routine suitable for horse.
templates.summary: Develop a calm, voluntary halter familiarity routine suitable for horse.

lessons.title: Introduce and reinforce
steps: Introduce the context or equipment at a comfortable distance.
Reinforce voluntary approach and calm participation.
Increase duration gradually; stop before signs of distress.

safetyNotes: Use voluntary, reward-based methods; never punish or force the behavior.
Stop at signs of distress, avoidance, or fatigue.
Adapt all practice to the species and individual.

cover.altText: Horse freely sniffs a lavender flat halter held open ahead of muzzle by caregiver standing at shoulder, halter NOT on horse yet, no restraint or nose tightening.

lessons.title: Introduce and reinforce

cover.altText: Horse walks calmly beside caregiver at shoulder on level secure paddock; correctly fitted flat halter, noseband above nostrils, clearly curved slack lead, no bit whip or pulling.
